title: Untitled (full moon rising behind the ruin)

terms_note: Model and Space are both Apache 2.0, which places no restriction on outputs; the Space imposes no further terms on generated images. note: The prompt was written by the curator, an AI; chosen from a batch of four on looks alone (a first moonrise came out with the pier far too intact, decks and railings and all; a sumi-e ink wash grew mountains behind Brighton and a ghostly seal in the corner; two rain-puddle photographs put the pier on the shingle or forgot the reflection). The image is shown unedited apart from resizing for the web.
